'''[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Warris''' was a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] recruiter with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. When he and his supervisor turned down [[Plat Mallar]], they both received an earful from [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]].
